ios.desc:
Dressme4 shows you complete outfits for the occasion you are dressing for, with the price of every piece and a link to buy it.

Choose the occasion: wedding guest, office, date night, party, beach, cruise or a casual weekend, and browse looks that are ready to wear: dress, shoes, bag and layers already matched. See how the outfit looks on a model, try it on with your own photo, save it to your favorites and shop each piece from the store.

Need something more specific? Ask the AI stylist. Describe the place, the weather and your style, "rooftop dinner on Friday", "job interview", "beach trip in July", and get outfit ideas in seconds.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH DRESSME4

• Outfits by occasion: complete looks for weddings, the office, dates, parties, the beach and weekends
• Ready-to-wear looks: see the whole outfit on a model before you buy
• Shop the look: every piece with its price and a link to the store
• Try it on yourself: upload a full-body photo and see the outfit on you
• AI stylist: outfit ideas for any event, mood or dress code
• Create your own look: pick a color, or a garment you already own, and Dressme4 matches the rest
• Color analysis: find the color combinations that work together
• Favorites: save the looks you love and come back to them any time

Dressme4 takes you from "I don't know what to wear" to a complete outfit in seconds. Whether you are planning what to wear to a wedding, building a work wardrobe or looking for a date night outfit, everything is matched, priced and ready.

Free to browse. Premium unlocks unlimited favorites, chat and try-ons.
